item.title: Attitude System
item.description: Attitude Range Attitude ranges from -5 (hostile nemesis, may attack on sight) to +5 (fanatical love and adoration). Initial Attitude GM determines initial attitude based on: Race Appearance Social class Rank Prior reputation First meeting typical range: -2 to +2 +2: Friendly disposition -2: Unfriendly disposition 0: Neutral/indifferent Attitude Progression First interaction can shift to -3/+3 range Progressing further requires significant actions or stakes Roleplay and actions affect attitude naturally Attitude Effects on Favors AttitudeCost Modifier-5Triple the cost0+20% markup+3Half price or IOU+5Free (fanatical devotion) Tags:Social.

item.title: Strain
item.description: Strain is the cost of overreaching magic: failed casts accumulate it, strain makes further casting harder, and past the limit it becomes wounds. Failed [Casting Check] of a Tier 1+ spell → +1 Strain.
